title: Frobenius-module equivalence for powered geometric pullback
statement: Let k₀,k₁ be finite fields, ℓ a prime invertible in both, X/k₀ and C/k₁ schemes, and r a natural number with #k₁=(#k₀)^r. Choose a ring isomorphism τ:k₀bar≃k₁bar and a scheme morphism c:C→X. Suppose v:Cbar→Xbar lies over c and intertwines Fr_C with Fr_X^r. No relation between the structural maps of c or the closure projection of v is required for this local assertion. For every finite point s of C, there are x in X with c(s)=x and e>0 satisfying q_s=q_x^e and, simultaneously for every source constructible Weil sheaf G [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], a Frobenius-module equivalence ((G_x).powFrobenius e) ≃ (P(G))_s. Here P is the explicit powered pullback [def-zl-powered-geometric-pullback], q denotes residue cardinality, and the stalk Frobenius uses the complete residue-degree return [def-weil-local-frobenius-trace].

proof.text: Set x=c(s) and e=[κ(s):κ(x)]. The injective residue field map identifies finite fields. Finite-field cardinalities give e>0, q_s=q_x^e, and r*deg_k₁(s)=e*deg_k₀(x). These choices do not depend on G.

proof.text: Compose the canonical lift of s with v and the inverse closure-spectrum isomorphism. Its projection is x and it is periodic after r*deg_k₁(s) source steps. The proved change-of-lift equivalence identifies its return with e powers of the canonical source stalk Frobenius. This uses the existing nonempty_equiv_stalkAt and frobeniusEnd_stalkAt_mul APIs.

proof.text: Use the iterated powered-pullback Weil-map square. Global-sections transport along the closure-spectrum isomorphism is an isomorphism. The transport composition law shows it intertwines the two returns. Convert it to a linear equivalence, form a Frobenius-module equivalence, and compose with the change-of-lift equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem poweredGeometricPullback_stalkEquiv
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] [Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)]
    {X C : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [C.Over (Spec (.of k₁))]
    (r : ℕ) (hcard : Nat.card k₁ = Nat.card k₀ ^ r)
    (τ : AlgebraicClosure k₀ ≃+* AlgebraicClosure k₁)
    (c : C ⟶ X)
    (u : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    (hup : u ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiberProj =
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiberProj ≫ c)
    (hu : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom ≫ u =
      u ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom)
    (s : C.finitePoints) :
    ∃ (x : X.finitePoints) (e : ℕ), c s.1 = x.1 ∧ 0 < e ∧
      (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).residueCard s.1 =
        (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).residueCard x.1 ^ e ∧
      ∀ G : WeilSheaf k₀ l X,
        Nonempty (((G.stalk x).powFrobenius e).Equiv
          (((poweredGeometricPullback u r hu).obj G).stalk s))
